video.access_note: The video has three parts. 00:00-04:15 recaps Friday's trades: an NQ setup he did not take and an ES long he took. 04:15-08:15 gives his weekly bias on ES/NQ. 08:15-12:30 covers crypto (BTC, TOTAL3), and 12:30-14:00 promotes his mastermind. I looked at all 7 sheets (28 scenes) and opened 12 full-size shots: #3, #4, #5, #11, #13, #14, #17, #18, #22, #24, #25, #27. Scene #20 runs 04m18s-09m42s as one scene, so its only frame is the last one, a TOTAL3 monthly chart. None of the ES/NQ monthly, weekly or daily charts from the weekly-bias section were captured, and neither were the first BTC charts. That section rests on the transcript alone, and the transcript is badly garbled (e.g. 'us and he' probably means ES and NQ). Legends, axis labels and position-tool labels are readable.

session_date.ref: Session recapped. #4/#5 00m36s-00m42s x-axis 'Fri 03 May '24 09:30' and 'Fri 03 May '24 12:20'. Heard: [00:15] 'the nasdaq trade from yesterday'.

regime.value: ES 4h: late-April swing highs around 5,148 (±3). Price dropped to about 5,039 on Wed 1 May/Thu 2 May, and a 4h wick briefly traded under a drawn low line. Fri 3 May then rallied from about 5,105 through those highs to a 5,162.25 high and closed at 5,161.50. On the 1h chart, the 08:00 ET NFP bar left a gray imbalance box at about 5,112-5,137 with a dashed midline around 5,125. After an early high of about 5,167 (±1, ~09:56 ET), price pulled back to about 5,127 at ~11:10 ET, which is inside the box and just above its midline. It then trended up for the rest of the day. NQ followed the same pattern: its 5m low of about 17,895 sat inside the 1h box, and it closed at 18,025.50.
regime.ref: #11 02m06s legend 'S&P 500 E-mini Futures · 4h · CME O5154.50 H5162.25 L5152.75 C5161.50'. #13 03m12s 1h legend 'O5154.25 H5162.25 L5153.75 C5161.50' with the gray box. #14/#17/#18 5m/1m views of the pullback into the box. #3 NQ 5m price label 18025.50. Box edges, the April highs, the ~5,039 low, the ~5,167 high and the ~5,127 pullback low are inferred from where they sit between axis labels (±1-3 pts).

news.value: Probably NFP (April jobs report), 08:30 ET Fri 3 May 2024. He does not clearly name any release.
news.ref: Seen: #3/#5 5m ES and NQ make a single huge expansion bar at 08:30 ET (12 bars before the 09:30 marker). Calendar: NFP was released Fri 3 May 2024. Heard: [02:45] 'we had a clumsy free market and usually an entree never wants the bomb however i saw this is a pretty good opportunity'. I read this as 'usually I don't want to trade [this kind of day], but I saw a good opportunity'; it is too garbled to confirm.

bias.value: Friday intraday: bullish, expecting price to hold the 1h imbalance and its equilibrium after the NFP expansion. Coming week (6-10 May): bullish on ES and NQ. The monthly imbalance has been filled; he expects the weekly imbalance to be invalidated and a push to new all-time highs. Short term, he warns that price is 'coming into' a strong selling area / 'weekly breaker' and a small weekly pullback is possible. BTC and altcoins: bullish, with a next leg to about 87k (BTC) and about 2T (TOTAL3).

setups_not_taken.value: NQ 5m long, shown but not taken (Fri 3 May 2024). Position box: entry 17,996.75, stop 17,951.50 (45.25 pts), target 18,049.50 (52.75 pts), tool R:R 1.17. The box starts around 11:50 ET. The target sits at about the early-session high (~18,050). The stop is at the bottom of a small gray box (~17,952-17,972, midline ~17,962) above the 1h imbalance, where the low was about 17,895. The tool reads 'Open P&L -6.25' at the box's end. Neither the target nor the stop was reached before Friday's close: the post-entry high was about 18,030 and the low about 17,970. That would make this a hypothetical open position, not a result.
setups_not_taken.ref: #4 00m36s legend 'NASDAQ 100 E-mini Futures · 5 · CME'; tool 'Target: 52.75 (0.29%) 211', 'Stop: 45.25 (0.25%) 181', 'Open P&L: -6.25, Qty: 1.105, Risk/Reward Ratio: 1.17'; axis labels 18049.50/17996.75/17951.50 match the distances. The box start time, the post-entry high/low and the small-box edges are inferred from pixel positions. Heard: [00:15]-[00:30] 'the nasdaq trade from yesterday ... that i never ended up taking ... could eventually been a trade but i didn't end up taking'. No reason given for skipping it.

quality_notes: The ES trade is well evidenced by readable position-tool labels, but fills, size and P&L are never shown, so the result is chart-level only. The entry time and all zone edges are pixel estimates. The ES/NQ weekly-outlook charts (04:15-08:15) were not captured because they fall in one long scene, #20, whose only frame is TOTAL3. The weekly bias therefore has no price levels and is heard only, from a badly garbled transcript that doesn't clearly separate ES from NQ. 12:30-14:00 is mastermind promotion.
